lines.zh: 缓慢蠕动前行，声音嘶哑。
lines.en: Moves slowly, with a hoarse voice.

lines.zh: 皮肤上的伤口不断渗出血丝。
lines.en: Wounds ooze blood constantly.

lines.zh: 张开利爪在地面上刮擦。
lines.en: Scratches the ground with sharp claws.
Whirs softly, with a deep voice.
Groans in a suffocating manner.

lines.zh: 舔舐伤口，舔出一滩血水。
lines.en: Licks wounds, producing a puddle of blood.

lines.zh: 用头部摩擦地面，制造声响。
lines.en: Rub head on the ground, producing sounds.
Slowly crawls out from the rock wall.

lines.zh: 在地面上拖行身体前行。
lines.en: Drag its body on the ground as it moves.
Vanishes into the darkness with a hiss.
My shadow slides along the cave wall.
The deeper I go, the faster I crawl.

lines.zh: 半睁着眼睛，盯着某个方向。
lines.en: Half-open eyes, staring in a direction.

lines.zh: 用粗糙的手指触碰地面。
lines.en: Touched the ground with rough fingers.

lines.zh: 喉咙里发出轻微的声音。
lines.en: Throat makes a slight noise.

lines.zh: 半眯起眼睛，似乎在思考。
lines.en: Half-closed eyes, seems to think.
Bent head, seems to smell the ground.

lines.zh: 舌头舔了舔嘴唇，发出湿响。
lines.en: Tongue licked lips, making a wet sound.

lines.zh: 缓慢转动脑袋，扫视周围。
lines.en: Slowly turned head, sweeping the surroundings.
Makes a low breathing sound.

lines.zh: 身体微微颤抖，似乎在调整状态。
lines.en: Body slightly trembles, adjusting its state.
Stares into the distance, eyes hollow.

lines.zh: 在石缝里数着自己的心跳。
lines.en: I count my own heartbeats in the crevice.
In the dark my flesh thickens slowly.
Waiting so long, my joints creak.

lines.zh: 听着地下水滴，一动不动。
lines.en: I listen to dripping water without moving.
Suddenly lunges at the player.
Hisses, staring at the player.
Exposes fangs, making a threatening sound.

lines.zh: 从阴影中跳出，向玩家攻击。
lines.en: Jumps out of the shadow, attacks the player.
Stares at the player, with a low voice.

lines.zh: 张开大嘴，准备咬向玩家。
lines.en: Opens wide mouth, ready to bite the player.

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，向玩家逼近。
lines.en: Hisses, advancing towards the player.

lines.zh: 伸出触手，试图抓住玩家。
lines.en: Stretches tentacles, trying to grab the player.

lines.zh: 发出警告，让玩家保持距离。
lines.en: Issues a warning, keeping the player at a distance.

lines.zh: 目光紧盯着玩家，发出低吼。
lines.en: Fixes gaze on the player, making a low growl.

lines.zh: 你带的光，刺痛我的眼眶。
lines.en: The light you carry stings my eyes.

lines.zh: 这么深的地方，你也敢来。
lines.en: You dare come this deep.

lines.zh: 我认得你身上的洞穴味。
lines.en: I know the cave smell on you.
Do not look back at the shadow behind you.
I am listening to the ground under you.

lines.zh: 你举高火把，我贴在更低处。
lines.en: Raise your torch; I cling lower.

lines.zh: 每往下一层，我更强一分。
lines.en: Each layer down makes me stronger.

lines.zh: 你数过自己还剩几步吗？
lines.en: Have you counted your remaining steps?

lines.zh: 我的眼睛长在你看不见处。
lines.en: My eyes grow where you cannot see.

lines.zh: 你吸气太急，影子都跟着抖。
lines.en: Your breath races; even my shadow shakes.
Cave wails
Painful scream
Decaying moan
Terrifying roar
Desperate cry
Injured roar
Weak hiss
Dying howl
Weak cry
Loud wail

lines.zh: 你身上的光芒让我恐惧。
lines.en: Your light hurts my eyes.

lines.zh: 你的存在激起了我的饥饿。
lines.en: Your presence stokes my hunger.

lines.zh: 你的气息中散发着腐烂的味道。
lines.en: Your scent is rotten.
Why are you so close?
My prey is near.

lines.zh: 你的血肉对我有吸引力。
lines.en: Your flesh calls to me.

lines.zh: 你身上的光辉让我痛苦。
lines.en: Your glow pains me.

lines.zh: 你的火光烫，退到石柱后面。
lines.en: Your torchlight burns; get behind the pillar.
Your presence lures me.

lines.zh: 我的时间到了，该吃你了。
lines.en: My time has come to feast on you.
You touched me!
You disturbed my territory.
My body touched you.
Our paths crossed.
You disrupted my peace.
You intruded on my domain.
You touched my tentacles.
My tentacles touched you.
You blocked my path.
You collided with me.

lines.zh: 岩缝里，还有一个我在等。
lines.en: In the crack, another me still waits.
Find my mate.

lines.zh: 另一个影子，怎么还不贴过来？
lines.en: Where is the other shadow that should cling to me?
Join me.
My kind are here.
Die with me.

lines.zh: 深洞里两个影子靠在一起。
lines.en: Two shadows lean together in the deep cave.
Find my kind.
Live with me.
My kind are near.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响的皮肤摩擦着岩壁。
lines.en: Skin scrapes against the rock with a hiss.

lines.zh: 岩石上滴落着我体内液体的痕迹。
lines.en: Droplets of my fluid leave marks on the stone.

lines.zh: 我用爪子在岩石上留下痕迹。
lines.en: Claws scratch at the stone, leaving marks.

lines.zh: 饥饿的咕噜声从喉咙深处响起。
lines.en: A growl rumbles from deep in the throat.

lines.zh: 洞穴中的阴影仿佛在注视我。
lines.en: Shadows in the cave seem to watch me.

lines.zh: 我用触手探查着洞穴的每一个角落。
lines.en: Touching the corners of the cave with my tentacles.

lines.zh: 我需要食物，这里适合埋伏。
lines.en: I need prey, this place is perfect for ambushing.
Decaying flesh draws me in.

lines.zh: 岩石间渗出的液体开始发光。
lines.en: Fluid seeping from the stone begins to glow.
I hide this rotten meat in the crevice.

lines.zh: 玩家的声音在我耳边回荡。
lines.en: The player's voice echoes in my ears.
I've found your trail.

lines.zh: 你的气息透露了你的位置。
lines.en: Your scent gives you away.

lines.zh: 你已经逃不出我的手掌心。
lines.en: You can't escape my grasp.
I can smell your fear.

lines.zh: 你的每一次呼吸都在提醒我。
lines.en: Your every breath reminds me.

lines.zh: 你的一举一动都在我的视野中。
lines.en: Every move you make is in my sight.
You can't ignore my presence.

lines.zh: 我将你锁定在了我的视线里。
lines.en: You are locked in my sight.

lines.zh: 你的一切动作都在我掌握之中。
lines.en: Every action is within my control.

lines.zh: 你在洞口停了一下，我记住了。
lines.en: You paused at the cave mouth; I remember.
The deep dark carries word to me.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声回了三次，我数清了。
lines.en: Your steps echoed thrice; I counted.
I follow the torchlight to you.
You picked the wrong cave to descend.
I need not chase; you cannot leave.
Your fear serves me.
I will taste your pain.

lines.zh: 洞越深，我的影子越清楚。
lines.en: The deeper the cave, the sharper my shadow.
I will make you feel fear.

lines.zh: 你的哀嚎将回荡在这洞穴。
lines.en: Your screams will echo in this cave.
My shadow clings to you first.
You will fall into endless darkness.
Pain will be your companion.

lines.zh: 我要将你囚禁在这黑暗之中。
lines.en: I will imprison you in this darkness.

lines.zh: 恐惧将伴随你直到最后一刻。
lines.en: Fear will accompany you to your last moment.

lines.zh: 你拐过的每个弯，我都先到。
lines.en: I reach every corner before you.

lines.zh: 黑暗里，距离对你没有意义。
lines.en: In the dark, distance means nothing to you.

lines.zh: 我在你身后第三块石头处。
lines.en: I am three stones behind you.
My shadow hugs the rock and follows you.
I wait for the second you turn around.
I know these tunnels better than you.
The deeper you go, the hungrier I get.
Stop counting drips; count your steps.
I am already on your way back.

lines.zh: 这里的黑暗替你挑了我。
lines.en: This darkness picked me for you.
Pierces your skin with sharp spikes!
Your flesh in my mouth!
Feel my fangs!
Avoid my claws!

lines.zh: 洞穴深处的影子，替你数着日子。
lines.en: The deep-cave shadow counts your days.
Tear your bones apart!
Pain will follow you!
The deeper the cave, the more I look like you.
Survive in despair!
Quake in the darkness!
The shadow arrives first, the claws after.
You cannot grab a patch of black.
A wound made in the dark does not heal.
I cling to you; you cannot shake me.
This claw strikes for the cave.
Your blood makes me grow a notch.
Darkness calls me!
Dig deep to find me!
I'm in the cave!
You can't escape my eyes!
Fear will be with you!
I'm the messenger of night!

lines.zh: 探索者，欢迎来到我的家！
lines.en: Explorer, welcome to my home!

lines.zh: 从钟乳石滴水里，我凝出形。
lines.en: From the dripstone water, I take shape.
You will never find me!
Wait for you in the darkness!
The cave floor split; I squeezed out.
Behind the stalactites, I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 第一个夜晚过去了，我醒来。
lines.en: The first night has passed; I wake.

lines.zh: 地下的空气有了我的味道。
lines.en: The underground air now smells of me.
I climb up through an old fissure.
At the mine's end, I stand up.

lines.zh: 你的火把照出一双眼睛。
lines.en: Your torch reveals a pair of eyes.
The wet stone seeps me out.
The deeper the place, the earlier I arrive.
The cave has raised me.
Burns with fire
Fell and hurt

lines.zh: 冷水灌进影子，我沉了下去。
lines.en: Cold water pours into my shadow; I sink.
Explosion hurt
Arrow shot
Magic burn
Starved and weak
Lightning struck

lines.zh: 岩层没了，我连影子都散。
lines.en: The rock is gone; even my shadow scatters.
